crossRefs.note: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
of the nations concerning which Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they…
God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary…
My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

people.name: Hamor
people.line: A Hivite prince, father of Shechem.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: Founded the city where Dinah was raped

translations.web: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
translations.bsb: But Hamor said to them, “My son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
translations.kjv: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
translations.asv: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you, give her unto him to wife.
